title: Method for accelerating federal learning aiming at data and equipment isomerism under edge calculation

pse.problem: Inefficient Federal Learning (FL) training under Edge Computing due to heterogeneous terminal devices with varying hardware characteristics and non-independent and unevenly distributed data sets.
pse.solution_function: Cooperative model training between terminal equipment and edge node server to reduce terminal energy consumption and alleviate computational power deficiency.
pse.solution_structure: Terminal devices, edge node servers, global model, auxiliary data set on edge servers, candidate set of terminal devices per area.
pse.solution_implementation: Random sampling of data sets on terminal equipment, uploading sampled data sets to edge nodes, distributing global model to edge nodes and selected terminal equipment, training auxiliary models on edge servers using artificial set, performing collaborative training on terminal equipment and edge node servers, aggregating and updating the model.
pse.effect: Reduced energy consumption of terminal equipment, alleviated computational power deficiency, potential for shorter training times and increased model accuracy
